basis: sol-baseline-result.json and exact new input/output0003; operation-before-result.json real-parser replay
before: For an explicit review/recheck of saved rules without requested changes, set operation=review_rules, use reuse/none for both modes and omit edit intents. Review validates the selected current attachment and candidate; it does not draft, activate, or finish an edit. A request combining review and changes needs one clarification of the intended operation. A current attached source is already supplied by the host; do not ask to upload it again. Ask a specific semantic question if its content is ambiguous.
after: For review/recheck without requested changes, use the separate review_rules branch: status=planned, operation=review_rules, read_mode=reuse or none, action_mode=reuse or none, summary; optionally retain an explicitly selected intended_client. Omit read_intent, action_intent, action_intents, action_outcome and action_strategy entirely, including null or empty placeholders. The existing candidate is selected by the host; action_outcome is not a review target selector. Edit branches have no operation field. A request combining review and changes needs the clarification branch {status:clarification,question}; preserve the whole request and do not discard its change to obtain a review plan.
